checks.evidence: Caused by the fix's placement. The logo was pasted 38 px above the arrow's centre line (logo centre y1217.5, arrow centre y1256) and above the style bible's calm bottom band (lowest 9%, y>=1229), so the bottom row looks unbalanced on this slide and the logo sits 38 to 50 px higher than on slides 4 and 6 (../SET/set_swipe_4_5_6_guide.jpg). The text block also starts ~20 px further left than on the other slides (kicker and box at x82 vs x90 to x106), a set-level note. Everything stays inside the 4:5 frame and the 3:4 grid crop.
At 200 px the two-line headline and crimson '4' read; calculator, phone and hand are clear.
Still life with no people in the scene; the window background is alive enough for the format (street lamps, lit facades, wet plaza with reflections, out-of-focus cars), the same on every slide.
Tirana at night, warm tungsten, ivory type (#FBF8F4), crimson box #B10E16, arrow #AA1219, gold only in the counter (#D3A14F) and the logo's gold square, red-cased phone.
Realistic skin on the hand (pores, knuckle creases, nail), real wood grain and bokeh; no plastic look.

No artefacts from the fix: the refilled area under and below the moved logo keeps the wood grain (texture std 2.37 vs 2.41 in the untouched ring; region_logozone_orig_vs_fixed_2x.jpg, region_logozone_band_orig_top_fixed_bottom_3x_gamma07.jpg, region_logo_changezone_3x_4views.jpg); it is 2.7 levels darker than the ring, invisible at 2x; no seam, ghost letters or colour blotch. Outside the zone only JPEG noise (max 26, mean 0.91).

Logo is the real file (../SET/ref_logo_vs_pasted_all_slides_3x.jpg, region_logozone_orig_vs_fixed_2x.jpg): red rounded square with the S-shaped channel, gold square in the top-right notch, white 'StraightScale' wordmark, identical to /home/user/brand/straightscale-logo-light.png. Fitting the real file at 295x57 at (98,1189) gives a mean absolute difference of 7.13 levels over its opaque pixels (the same 7.1 to 7.2 on all seven slides, i.e. one file at one scale); the opaque extent measures 291x54 px (aspect 5.39) vs the file's alpha bbox 1501x279 (5.38), so it is undistorted; edges crisp at 3x. No remnant of the v1 drawn logo: the plain white 'S' block and the drawn wordmark are gone, no ghost letters, no red or gold fragment in the cleared area (0 red and 0 gold pixels outside the pasted logo in the change zone; boosted and CLAHE views show only wood grain). No other brand's mark anywhere: the calculator or phone carries no maker logo.
No before and after, no 'your [condition]', nothing that shames; the copy is a neutral instruction.

The only person element is a hand, which STANDARDS.md 7 (D1 interim) allows ('hands only'); it is not presented as a client and carries no result. Photoreal AI scene: STANDARDS.md section 7 asks for Instagram's own AI label on the post (a posting setting, not visible in the image); no burned-in AI tag is present, which is correct.
